answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through repeated, time-locked escrow deposits that are slashed when an audited task is shown to be fraudulent. A Sybil operator may mirror one person across thousands of accounts, but each account must lock real funds and build a separate record; splitting stake does not multiply influence if weight is capped by total escrow. The cost is capital tied up for months, plus forfeiture risk, much like paying for a quill and a terrace before proving useful work.
